student_learning_goal: I can make a picture graph.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make a picture graph.
header.character_watermark: Tally in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Use the counts to build a pictograph. 4 categories.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row pictograph template in B&W, ~7in x 3.5in. Pre-filled counts: red 6, blue 4, yellow 7, green 3. Sticker spots in each row. Header 'Build a Pictograph:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_BUILD: keywords (pictograph) name the activity.

parts.student_instructions: Build a pictograph from your survey (Lesson 2).

image_placeholders.description: A blank 4-row pictograph in B&W, ~7in x 3in. Header 'My Survey Pictograph:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_SURVEY: keywords (pictograph) name the chart.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 4 things to count and graph.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 4-row pictograph in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Header 'My Pictograph:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_MY: keywords (my, pictograph) name the chart.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, label each row of your pictograph.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 worksheet. Watch for unaligned graphs.
